$description: BIM MATERIALS token category — anchored to IFC 4.3 IfcMaterial + bSDD URI references. Pset_Material* property sets.
$description_es: Categoría de tokens MATERIALS de BIM — anclada a IfcMaterial de IFC 4.3 + referencias URI de bSDD. Conjuntos de propiedades Pset_Material*.

$value.description: Single-component material. References bSDD URI for canonical classification (Uniclass Pm, OmniClass material classes, MasterFormat).
Single layer in a multi-layer wall / slab / roof assembly. Carries thickness + LayerSetName.
Ordered set of material layers comprising an element (e.g., wall: gypsum + insulation + brick).
IFC 4 alternative to LayerSet for non-stacked composite materials (e.g., reinforced concrete = concrete + rebar).

Pset_MaterialThermal.$description: Thermal property set — material-level properties only. ThermalConductivity (λ, W/m·K) is a material property. ThermalTransmittance (U-value, W/m²K) is an assembly property per ISO 10077; apply via Pset_WallCommon, Pset_DoorCommon, or Pset_MaterialLayerSet at the assembly level.
Pset_MaterialThermal.$description_es: Conjunto de propiedades térmicas — solo propiedades a nivel de material. ThermalConductivity (λ, W/m·K) es una propiedad del material. ThermalTransmittance (valor U, W/m²K) es una propiedad de ensamble según ISO 10077; aplíquese mediante Pset_WallCommon, Pset_DoorCommon, o Pset_MaterialLayerSet a nivel de ensamble.
